title: Spec: multi-gateway route validation
description: Define protocol for nodes hearing multiple gateways to cross-validate routing information. When a node receives DIOs from 2+ gateways, it compares: DODAG version, root identity, advertised metrics. If one gateway's routing diverges significantly from consensus (different root, inconsistent version, metric outlier), flag it and prefer the consensus gateways. Add to spec/05-routing.md and spec/08-gateway-coordination.md. This detects a compromised gateway advertising bogus routes to attract traffic.
